claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation precondition for item occupancy
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The fold-back command is only legal when the transformed vessel has no creatures aboard, and there is no activation-side predicate for that condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item destruction on transformed form reaching 0 hit points
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing destruction policies only model charge-exhaustion breakage, not destruction caused by a transformed item's vessel form being reduced to 0 HP.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.
